description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. --sha without --pr: the train's batch (train.tier2_command through scripts/gate-batch) or a hand --sha run, uncached. Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.
